Posted November 8, 2000
Special to MarijuanaNews.com
From De Telegraaf
A mass circulation, Amsterdam-based paper distributed nationally.
November 7, 2000

BELGIUM WANTS TO IMPORT WEED FROM HOLLAND.
(MarijuanaNews note: The Dutch often refer to marijuana as " wiet " -- meaning weed– pronounced " veet. " Kindly translated Nol.)

Weed to be used as a pain reliever

Belgium wants to start importing weed from Holland for medical purposes,
starting January 2001.
See
Dutch National Cannabis Agency To Be Launched To Regulate Cannabis Production for Medical And Scientific Purposes

The Belgian minister of Health, Magda Aelvoet, gave her green light for medical marijuana from Holland yesterday. The reason is that marijuana has proven to be an effective pain reliever. MS patients were mentioned to be one of the target groups, amongst others.

Aelvoets spokesman said that the cannabis is to be used in test projects and under strict surveillance only. The cannabis will be used for pain relieving tea at first, but if that works insufficiently, the patients can also smoke it, through a pipe, they are not meant to roll and smoke joints, however.

If this approach is successful, Aelvoet wants to expand the experiment to a larger scale, but for that, Belgium has to have a change of law first.

To avoid following a long law procedure for this try-out project, she chose to import the cannabis from Holland.
(MarijuanaNews note: Meanwhile in the UK,The Independentreported today that Mo Mowlam, the Cabinet Minister with responsibility for drugs policy, said thatcannabis could be legalised for medicinal purposes by the end of next year, after trials.

But she was forced to retract her comments after Downing Street insisted that such a move would not happen for

at least four years. A spokesman for Number 10 said: " If any application [to the Medicines Control Agency] were made, we do not expect it before 2004.

It is a really long process. "

Ms Mowlam said later: " If that is what Downing Street is saying, it is right. I probably under-estimated the time it would take to get through the different phases which might be necessary. "


(MarijuanaNews note: How time flies when you are not in pain.)
See
The Complete Intellectual and Moral Bankruptcy of UK Cannabis Policies. 3 Articles.
